description: This file contains the implementation of the APCU caching class within the OpenCart system, specifically under the namespace Opencart\System\Library\Cache. It defines a class that provides methods for caching operations such as get, set, delete, and flush using APCu.

classes.name: Apcu
classes.description: This class provides an interface for caching data using the APCu extension, including methods to get, set, delete, and flush cache entries.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Apcu cache object, setting the expiration time and verifying if APCu is enabled.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a cached value by key.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores a value in the cache with an optional expiration time.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a cache entry by key.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Clears all entries in the APCu cache.
